name: Black-waved Flannel Moth
desc: Black-waved Flannel Moth (Megalopyge crispata): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 28 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Megalopyge crispata, the black-waved flannel moth, crinkled flannel moth or white flannel moth, is a moth of the Megalopygidae family.
